notes.title: Get Failed State Demo for free
notes.notes:
Since August 10, a free demo version of the project "Failed State" developed by INT-Works and Red Spinner Studio has become available on Steam.

"What do Failed State and WindSoul have in common?" - you might ask. The answer is simple. Failed State runs on the modified software kernel used in WindSoul. This kernel is designed specifically as a full-featured add-on for the Unity3D engine, it has good portability and scalability from a programmatic point of view.

Failed State will be a parallel project under development for INT-Works along with WindSoul. So stay tuned and leave impressions and feedback about this project. We listen to any feedback.

Download Demo from right menu on this page:
 [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/409350] Failed State [/url]

notes.title: Glimpse of WindSoul Soundtrack
notes.notes:
I am proud to announce the beginning of official cooperation with the wonderful composer Vincent Black OST, who decided to write an exclusive soundtrack for "WindSoul" project.

Writing a soundtrack for this project is, in fact, a non-trivial task, music should not only pay attention to the atmosphere but also emphasize the visual style and charm of the game. And it seems that the new composer deals with these tasks just perfectly!

Today we are ready to present you one of the compositions:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GjgU1tmP6TA]
